additionalTopics.title: Academic integrity framework
additionalTopics.summary: Under the ANU Academic Integrity Rule 2021 framework, suspected breaches are addressed via informal review or formal inquiry; students are entitled to written notice and a support person (such as ANUSA or Dean of Students); findings are classified into No Breach (no record), Poor Academic Practice (unintentional/careless; penalties include reprimand, re-assessment, or mark reduction up to 25% of assessment marks, or up to 10% for first 48 units of undergraduate coursework; recorded internally, not on transcript), or Academic Misconduct (serious/intentional; formal penalties up to course fail, facility denial, suspension, or exclusion).

actions: Consult the source for the applicable finding, conditions and response procedure.

claims.claimText: In the College of Asia & the Pacific, submitting AI-produced text as one's own is a clear breach of academic integrity; using AI to generate assignment structures or essay plans may be an integrity issue requiring course convenor guidance.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Using AI-produced text ‘as your own’
This is a clear academic integrity issue - a student doing this is passing of the work of someone/thing as their own.
Asking ChatGPT to write a 1000 word essay on ‘What was the most important reason for the wars in Vietnam?’

Using AI to generate structures for assignments such as essay plans
This may be an academic integrity issue. Structures are not neutral - they tell you what to talk about and what to ignore. These are vital parts of the work students are expected to do because a structure is in effect an argument about what is important enough to discuss.

claims.claimText: Under the ANU Academic Integrity Rule 2021 framework, suspected breaches are addressed via informal review or formal inquiry; students are entitled to written notice and a support person (such as ANUSA or Dean of Students); findings are classified into No Breach (no record), Poor Academic Practice (unintentional/careless; penalties include reprimand, re-assessment, or mark reduction up to 25% of assessment marks, or up to 10% for first 48 units of undergraduate coursework; recorded internally, not on transcript), or Academic Misconduct (serious/intentional; formal penalties up to course fail, facility denial, suspension, or exclusion).

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
No Breach
No Breach means that the course convenor concludes that the conduct has not breached the academic integrity principle. This is the end of the process. There will be no record on the student’s record or official transcript.
Poor Academic Practice
This is when the course convenor believes that the conduct is a breach of the academic integrity principle, however the conduct is excusable due to mitigating circumstances (e.g. personal, emotional, health-related circumstances, etc.) or the conduct is unintended, careless, inadvertent or uninformed. The breach is also not of a serious nature nor is it a recurrence.
The course convenor can take certain actions, e.g. require the student to

coursework.en: ANU delegates AI assessment permissions to course convenors. Students must check Canvas course outlines for specific AI rules in every course. Unapproved drafting is prohibited.
coursework.zh: ANU 将 AI 考核权限交由各课程负责人决定。学生必须查阅每门课程在 Canvas 上的具体规定。未经许可严禁使用 AI 起草作业。

exams.en: This review did not establish a current central ANU rule specifically permitting or prohibiting generative AI in examinations. Check the instructions for the particular assessment; general misconduct rules do not establish a blanket exam ban.
exams.zh: 本轮未核实 ANU 现行中央规定对考试中生成式 AI 的具体许可或禁令。应查阅具体考核指引；一般学术诚信规则不能证明全校考试一律禁止 AI。

disclosure.en: For ANU Law School submissions where AI tools are used, students must declare the application names, purpose, and extent/frequency; the declaration should be in the first footnote. For other ANU assessments, follow the course-specific instructions.
disclosure.zh: 在 ANU 法学院使用 AI 的作业中，必须声明工具名称、用途及程度/频率；声明建议放在第一条脚注。其他 ANU 课程考核遵循具体规定。

privacy_data.en: Staff and students must not enter confidential ANU data, student assessment materials, or unconsented personal data into external AI services.
privacy_data.zh: 教职员与学生严禁将 ANU 机密数据、学生考核材料或未经同意的个人数据输入外部 AI 服务。

approved_tools.en: Microsoft Copilot Enterprise (with Commercial Data Protection) is available to all ANU staff and students via SSO. Adobe Firefly is provided for staff and specific creative cohorts.
approved_tools.zh: 微软 Copilot Enterprise（具备商业数据保护）通过单点登录面向全体 ANU 师生开放。Adobe Firefly 面向教职工及特定创意专业学生开放。

research_publication.en: Under Australian Research Council (ARC) policy cataloged by ANU Library, researchers applying for ARC grants must ensure the integrity and accuracy of applications and must disclose any use of generative AI. Under Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) policy cataloged by ANU Library, generative AI tools such as ChatGPT may not be listed as authors of an ACM published work; AI-assisted content creation must be fully disclosed.
research_publication.zh: ANU 图书馆收录的 ARC 规则适用于 ARC 资助申请，要求申请真实准确并披露生成式 AI 使用；ACM 规则适用于 ACM 出版作品，AI 不得列为作者且 AI 辅助内容创作须充分披露。不能将这些外部规则扩展为所有 ANU 研究或学位论文的统一规定。

academic_integrity.en: Under the ANU Academic Integrity Rule 2021 framework, suspected breaches are addressed via informal review or formal inquiry; students are entitled to written notice and a support person (such as ANUSA or Dean of Students); findings are classified into No Breach (no record), Poor Academic Practice (unintentional/careless; penalties include reprimand, re-assessment, or mark reduction up to 25% of assessment marks, or up to 10% for first 48 units of undergraduate coursework; recorded internally, not on transcript), or Academic Misconduct (serious/intentional; formal penalties up to course fail, facility denial, suspension, or exclusion).
academic_integrity.zh: 涉嫌违反学术诚信的情况可经非正式审查或正式调查，学生有回应、书面通知及支持人员等程序保障。结果包括无违规、学术规范不良或学术不端。学术规范不良的扣分上限通常为考核分数的25%，本科前48学分情形为10%；该分类不可与暂缓公开的2021年法条申诉期限混用。

teaching_guidance.en: Teaching staff are encouraged to design assessments that emphasize authentic learning and provide clear syllabus policies regarding generative AI.
teaching_guidance.zh: 鼓励教师设计注重真实学习过程的考核，并在课程教学大纲中明确生成式 AI 的使用政策。

security_procurement.en: All technical solutions being used for University business and/or on ANU managed devices must be approved by the University.
security_procurement.zh: 用于大学业务及／或 ANU 管理设备的所有技术方案须经大学批准。该范围不能扩展为所有私人学习或所有 AI 使用。

coursework.en: All ANU undergraduate and postgraduate taught coursework.
coursework.zh: ANU 全体本科生及授课型研究生课程作业。

exams.en: Review gap for examination-specific rules; course and assessment instructions remain applicable.
exams.zh: 考试专门规则的核验缺口；仍应查阅具体课程与考核指引。

disclosure.en: ANU Law School assessment submissions where AI tools are used; other assessments follow course instructions.
disclosure.zh: ANU 法学院使用 AI 工具的考核作业；其他考核遵循具体课程要求。

privacy_data.en: All staff, students, and university data assets.
privacy_data.zh: 全体教职员、学生及大学数据资产。

approved_tools.en: Centrally provisioned institutional software and services.
approved_tools.zh: 全校统一配置的机构软件与服务。

research_publication.en: ARC grant applications and ACM published works respectively.
research_publication.zh: 分别适用于 ARC 资助申请与 ACM 出版作品。

academic_integrity.en: Reviewed ANU learner guidance on suspected breaches; held statutory clocks excluded.
academic_integrity.zh: 已核实的 ANU 涉嫌违规学生指引；不包含暂缓公开的法条期限。

teaching_guidance.zh: 学术教职员与课程召集人。

security_procurement.en: Technical solutions for University business and/or ANU managed devices.
security_procurement.zh: 用于大学业务及／或 ANU 管理设备的技术方案。

title.zh: 澳大利亚国立大学生成式人工智能政策与指导

scope.en: Applies to all ANU coursework, assessment design, student conduct, staff grading, and institutional technical solutions.
scope.zh: 适用于 ANU 全部课程教学、考核设计、学生学术行为、教师评分以及机构技术方案。

do.en: Consult Canvas course outlines and assessment briefs for specific AI rules in every course.
do.zh: 查阅 Canvas 课程大纲与考核说明，了解每门课程的具体 AI 使用规定。

do.en: For ANU Law School submissions using AI, declare tool names, purpose, and extent; the declaration should be in the first footnote. For other courses, follow course instructions.
do.zh: 在 ANU 法学院使用 AI 的作业中，声明工具名称、用途及程度（建议置于第一条脚注）。其他课程遵循具体要求。

do.en: Log in with your ANU account to access endorsed Copilot Enterprise with commercial data protection.
do.zh: 使用 ANU 账号单点登录，使用具备商业数据保护的 Copilot Enterprise。

dont.en: Do not assume generative AI is permitted or banned in exams; check the specific assessment instructions.
dont.zh: 切勿假定考试允许或禁止使用生成式 AI；查阅具体考核指引。

dont.en: Do not upload student assignments or personal data into AI platforms without express consent.
dont.zh: 未经学生或当事人明确同意，严禁将学生作业或个人数据上传至 AI 平台。

dont.en: Do not submit AI-generated text or analysis as your own independent work without permission.
dont.zh: 未经许可，严禁将 AI 生成的文本或分析作为本人独立完成的作品提交。

claimScopes.claim-anu-003c: Student assessment IP and staff upload limits
claimScopes.claim-anu-004c: Enterprise AI tools licensing, eligibility, and quotas

claimScopes.draft-anu-017: College of Asia & the Pacific language/non-language courses

en: Check Canvas outlines and class summaries before using AI on any assessment task.
Ask your course convenor for written guidance if assessment AI permissions are unclear.
Cite all authorized generative AI assistance in accordance with course referencing standards.
zh: 在任何考核任务中使用 AI 前，先查阅 Canvas 课程大纲和说明。
如考核中的 AI 权限不明确，向课程召集人索取书面指引。
按照课程引用标准注明所有获准的生成式 AI 辅助。

en: Declare the specific name of every AI tool used in preparing your assessment.
State the exact purpose of tool use (e.g., grammar editing, brainstorming).
Disclose the extent and frequency of use, placing the declaration in the first footnote where recommended.
zh: 声明准备考核时使用的每个 AI 工具的具体名称。
说明使用工具的确切用途（如语法润色、头脑风暴）。
披露使用的程度和频率，建议在第一条脚注中声明。

en: Never upload confidential, identifiable personal, or third-party proprietary data into AI platforms.
Ensure student assignments are not uploaded to AI marking tools without explicit student consent.
Use ANU-approved enterprise services with data protection when handling university business.
zh: 切勿将机密、可识别的个人数据或第三方专有数据上传到 AI 平台。
确保未经学生明确同意不得将作业上传至 AI 批改工具。
处理大学业务时使用具有数据保护的 ANU 批准企业级服务。

en: Log in using your ANU account to ensure enterprise commercial data protection.
Do not enter personal or confidential university information into unapproved public freeware tools.
Verify whether your specific course has an allocated Adobe Firefly seat before planning coursework around it.
zh: 使用 ANU 账号登录以确保企业商业数据保护。
切勿将个人或机密大学信息输入未获批准的公共免费工具。
在围绕 Adobe Firefly 规划作业前，确认具体课程是否分配了相应席位。

en: Consult CLT resources for authentic assessment and AI design guidance.
zh: 查阅 CLT 教学资源以获取真实评估和 AI 设计指引。

en: Check the specific assessment instructions before assuming AI use is permitted.
zh: 在假定 AI 可用之前，查阅该项考核的具体指引。

en: For ARC applications, follow the ARC requirements described in the source.
For ACM works, follow the ACM authorship and disclosure requirements.
zh: 提交 ARC 申请时遵循来源所述的 ARC 要求。
向 ACM 出版作品投稿时遵循其作者资格与披露要求。

en: Consult the source for the applicable finding, conditions and response procedure.
zh: 查阅来源以确认具体认定、适用条件与回应程序。

en: Follow the University approval process when the stated business or managed-device scope applies.
zh: 属于大学业务或管理设备范围时，遵循大学审批程序。
